kind: Independent contributing-layout diagnostic; not baseline/acceptance evidence
environment: Linux Chromium, real React workspace with invented memory-API data
productionChanges: None. Study labels and CSS remain unchanged.
method: Measure shell scrollHeight and visually hidden Study label geometry/offsetParent. Then temporarily set display:none on those labels in this disposable browser page only and remeasure. This counterfactual isolates their contribution to shell overflow; removing accessibility labels is NOT proposed as a fix.
finding: Absolutely positioned sr-only writing-field labels use fixed app-shell as offsetParent. The last label below the viewport contributes to its programmatic scroll extent. Original scrollIntoView can therefore move the shell despite normal visible pane layout.
probeScript: import{createRequire}from'node:module';const{chromium}=createRequire(import.meta.url)('/workspace/browser-tools/node_modules/playwright');const browser=await chromium.launch({executablePath:'/usr/bin/chromium',args:['--no-sandbox']});const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1920,height:1009}});await page.goto('http://localhost:1432/tests/screenshots/index.html?empty=1&assistant=off&viewportReview=1&a4Editors=1&sourcesOpen=1&lang=en&originalReview=epub');const study=page.locator('#pane-study');await study.getByRole('button',{name:/INVENTED Viewport Project/}).first().click();await study.getByRole('button',{name:/INVENTED Viewport Study/}).first().click();await study.locator('section textarea').first().waitFor();console.log(JSON.stringify(await page.evaluate(()=>{const shell=document.querySelector('[data-testid=app-shell]');const before=shell.scrollHeight;const labels=[...document.querySelectorAll('#pane-study .sr-only')].map(e=>({tag:e.tagName,text:e.textContent.slice(0,40),top:e.getBoundingClientRect().top,bottom:e.getBoundingClientRect().bottom,parent:e.offsetParent?.getAttribute('data-testid'),position:getComputedStyle(e).position}));document.querySelectorAll('#pane-study .sr-only').forEach(e=>e.style.display='none');return{before,afterHidingOnlyVisuallyHiddenStudyElements:shell.scrollHeight,labels};}),null,2));await browser.close();
